questions.question: In an election, 2% of registered voters did not participate, and 500 votes were invalid. Two candidates A and B fought the election, and A defeated B by 200 votes. If 43% of the persons enrolled in the voter list cast their votes in favour of A, then what is the total number of the total casted votes?
questions.solution:
Given:

2% of voters did not cast their votes

Invalid votes = 500

The winner got 200 votes more than his opponent and he secured 43%

Calculation:

Let the total number of voters in the voting list be x

Total votes = (100 - 2)x/100 = 98x/100 = 0.98x

Total valid votes = 0.98x - 500

Number of votes loser got = 0.43x - 200

Total valid votes are:

⇒ 0.43x + 0.43x - 200 = 0.98x - 500

⇒ 0.86x - 200 = 0.98x - 500

⇒ 0.98x - 0.86x = 300

⇒ x = 2500

∴ The number of total casted votes = 2500 × (100 - 2)%

⇒ 2450

**The number of total casted votes is 2450.**

questions.question:
Evaluate the following.

sin 25° sin 65° – cos 25° cos 65°.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert 65° to its complementary angle.

⇒ sin 65° = cos(90° − 65°) = cos 25°

⇒ cos 65° = sin(90° − 65°) = sin 25°

Substitute these into the given expression:

⇒ sin 25° cos 25° − cos 25° sin 25° = 0

**∴ The correct answer is 0.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

sin 25° sin 65° − cos 25° cos 65°

**Formula Used:**

cos(A + B) = cos A cos B − sin A sin B

**Calculation:**

⇒ Re-write the given expression by taking the negative sign common:

⇒ − (cos 25° cos 65° − sin 25° sin 65°)

⇒ Apply the formula taking A = 25° and B = 65°

⇒ − cos(25° + 65°)

⇒ − cos(90°)

⇒ Since cos(90°) = 0

⇒ 0

**∴ The correct answer is 0.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Complementary Angles

sin(90° − θ) = cos θ | cos(90° − θ) = sin θ | tan(90° − θ) = cot θ

sin(A + B) = sin A cos B + cos A sin B | cos(A − B) = cos A cos B + sin A sin B

questions.question: A shopkeeper uses 940 gm weight in place of one kg weight. He sells it at 4% profit. What will be the actual profit percentage? (rounded off to two decimal places)
questions.solution:
Given:

A dishonest shopkeeper used 940 grams in place of 1000 grams

Challenge profit = 4%

Calculation:

Let the cost price of 1 gram be 1 rupee

For shopkeeper,

⇒ Cost price = Rs. 940

⇒ Selling price = 1000 × (100 + 4)% = Rs. 1040

⇒ The real profit of dishonest shopkeeper = [(1040 - 940)/940] × 100

⇒ The real profit of a dishonest shopkeeper = (100/940) × 100

⇒ The real profit of a dishonest shopkeeper = 10.64%

**∴ The real profit of a dishonest shopkeeper is 10.64**

questions.question: In what ratio must water be mixed with milk, costing ₹32 per litre, in order to get a mixture costing ₹28 per litre?
questions.solution:
Given:

We know that the cost of water = Rs. 0 per litre

Cost of milk = Rs. 32 per litre

Cost of mixture = Rs. 28 per litre

Formula used:

Cost of mixture = Total cost / Total quantity

Calculation:

Let the ratio of water and milk be "1 : a"

⇒ (1 × 0) + (a × 32) = (1 + a) × 28

⇒ 0 + 32a = 28 + 28a

⇒ 4a = 28

⇒ a =** 7**

**Now, the ratio of water and milk is 1 : 7**

questions.question: 5 women and 9 girls earn a total of ₹18,720 in 9 days, while 9 women and 16 girls earn a total of ₹ 52,080 in 14 days. How much will 12 women and 7 girls together earn (in ₹) in 13 days?
questions.solution:
Given:

5 women and 9 girls can earn Rs.18,720 in 9 days

9 women and 16 girls earn a total of ₹ 52,080 in 14 days

Concept:

Total work = number of workers doing work × time taken to complete the work.

Calculation:

(5W + 9G) × 9 = 18,720

⇒ (5W + 9G) = 2080 ----(i)

(9W + 16G) × 14 = 52080

⇒ (9W + 16G) = 3720 ----(ii)

solving equations (i) and (ii)

⇒ 45W + 81G = 18720 ---- (iii)

⇒ 45W + 80G = 18600 ---- (iv)

by subtraction equations (iii) and (iv)

⇒ 1G = Rs. 120 

Putting the value of G in equation (i)

⇒ 5W + 1080 = 2080

⇒ 5W = 1000

⇒ W = Rs.200

According to the question:

Money earned by 12 women and 7 girls in 13days

⇒ (12 × 200 + 7 × 120) × 13

⇒ (2400 + 840) × 13

⇒ 3240 × 13 = 42120

**∴ The required value is 42120.**

questions.question: An electronic store owner allows two successive discounts of 20% and 25% on each item. The store has a reward points scheme which enables a customer to get free shopping worth ₹0.10 on every 1 reward point credited to the customer’s account on previous purchases from the store. A customer decides to buy a laptop that is marked at ₹72,000. What will be its net selling price if he has 2850 reward points to his credit?
questions.solution:
Given: 

Discounts allowed by shopkeeper = 20 % and 25 %

Reward points = 2850 

Marked price = 72000

Formula used: 

Marked price = Selling price [100 / (100 – discount %)] × [100 / (100 - discount %)]

Calculation: 

Selling price = 72000 × [100 / (100 – 20%)] × [100 / (100 - 25%)]

⇒ 72000 × 80/100 × 75/100

⇒ 72 × 8 × 75

⇒ 43200

1 reward point → ₹0.10

2850 reward points → 285

Final S.P will be = 43200 - 285

⇒ 42915

**The net selling price is 42915.**

questions.question: What is the value of a³ + b³ + c³ if (a + b + c) = 0?

options.text: a² + b² + c² - ab - bc - ca

questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Let us assume values for variables such that a + b + c = 0.

Let a = 1, b = 1, and c = −2.

Calculate a³ + b³ + c³ ⇒ (1)³ + (1)³ + (−2)³ = 1 + 1 − 8 = −6.

Check the option 3abc ⇒ 3 × 1 × 1 × (−2) = −6.

Since both values match, the correct expression is 3abc.

**∴ The correct answer is 3abc.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

a + b + c = 0

**Formula Used:**

a³ + b³ + c³ − 3abc = (a + b + c)(a² + b² + c² − ab − bc − ca)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Substitute the given condition (a + b + c) = 0 into the standard identity.

⇒ a³ + b³ + c³ − 3abc = (0) × (a² + b² + c² − ab − bc − ca)

⇒ a³ + b³ + c³ − 3abc = 0

⇒ a³ + b³ + c³ = 3abc

**∴ The correct answer is 3abc.**

**__Additional Information__**

Important Algebraic Identity

a³ + b³ + c³ − 3abc = 1/2(a + b + c)[(a − b)² + (b − c)² + (c − a)²]

Sum of Squares Expansion

(a + b + c)² = a² + b² + c² + 2(ab + bc + ca)

Special Case Equality

If a² + b² + c² − ab − bc − ca = 0, then it implies a = b = c.
</p

cos (36° - A) cos (36° + A) + cos (54° - A) cos (54° + A)

cos (a - b) = cos a cos b + sin a sin b.

sin (90 - a) = cos a

⇒ sin(54º + A)sin(54º – A) + cos (54° – A)cos (54° + A)

questions.question: A 15 cm long perpendicular is drawn from the centre of a circle to its 40 cm long chord. Find the radius of the circle.
questions.solution:
Given :

A 15 cm long perpendicular is drawn from the centre of a circle to a 40 cm long chord

Concept used :

The line is drawn from the centre of a circle towards a chord always divides the chord in two equal parts and also perpendicular to the chord. 

Calculations :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b96a6e44c5313248880343f90e0bbdf28d0e70d51a1ae949581006e1d2c823b.png] 

Let the centre of the circle be 'O' and 'AO' is the radius 

Let the chord be 'AB' where 'C' is the midpoint of the chord.

The length of chord AB is 40 cm so AC is equal to 40 cm

Now according to the question 

AO² = OC² + AC²

AO2 = 152 + 202

AO2 = 225 + 400

AO2 = 625

AO = 25 cm

**The radius is 25 cm.**

questions.question: A thief steals a van at 3 : 00 a.m. and drives it at a speed of 57 km/h. The thief is discovered at 4 : 00 a.m. and the owner starts the chase with another van at a speed of 76 km/h. At what time will he catch the thief?
questions.solution:
**Given**

A thief steals a van at 3 : 00 a.m. and drives it at a speed of 57 km/h.

**Formula**

Time = Distance/Speed

**Calculation**

Speed of the car of the thief = 57 km/h

Since the robbery was discovered at 4:00 am

Distance travelled by the thief in 1 hour (4 - 3) = speed × time = 57 × 1 = 57 km

Speed of the owner of the car = 76 km/h

So, relative speed of the owner = (76 - 57) km/h = 19 km/h

∴ time taken to cover 57 km by the owner = 57/19 h = 3 hour

Time by watch = 4:00 am + 3 h = 7 : 00 am

**∴ The owner will overtake the thief at 7:00 am.**
